properties.title: EchoWorld: Learning Motion-Aware World Models for Echocardiography Probe Guidance

properties.version_basis: PDF identified by SHA-256 against assignments.json; title page read.

properties.description: JEPA-style spatial and motion world model pretraining on robot-recorded cardiac ultrasound, then fine-tuned with motion-aware attention to regress probe movement to ten standard planes.
ViT encoders pretrained with a latent predictor conditioned on masked regions and probe motion, followed by a motion-aware attention guidance head that regresses relative probe movement.

capability_assessments.rationale: Downgraded from L0 to not_world_model because implemented core world-model identity is not met: state.persistent (assertion:A08:0019) is partial (historical frames are re-encoded rather than propagating an updated latent state across steps), dynamics.temporal (assertion:A08:0041) is partial (motion pretraining predicts target features across arbitrary frame pairs rather than ordered rollouts), and the JEPA predictor is discarded at guidance time and shown only via qualitative RCDM visualizations (assertion:A08:0053). EchoWorld is therefore classed as a supporting representation-learning component rather than a core world model.

legacy_cells.B: EchoWorld: Learning Motion-Aware World Models for Echocardiography Probe Guidance
legacy_cells.C: Yang Yue, Yulin Wang, Haojun Jiang, Pan Liu, Shiji Song, Gao Huang
legacy_cells.S: Can historical ultrasound images and probe poses support prediction of probe movement needed to reach an unvisited target standard plane?
legacy_cells.T: Patients undergoing routine cardiac ultrasound examinations; detailed inclusion criteria and patient characteristics are not reported.
legacy_cells.U: Sonographers, including less-experienced operators; longer-term aspiration includes autonomous scanning systems.
legacy_cells.V: The probe movement needed to reach a selected target standard echocardiographic plane.
legacy_cells.AI: Ultrasound image frames; probe poses and relative 6-DOF pose differences
legacy_cells.AJ: Vision Transformer (ViT-Small) context/target encoders; motion encoder Aψ (architecture not specified)
legacy_cells.AL: Masked-region feature prediction with L1 loss; motion-conditioned feature prediction with InfoNCE contrastive loss; guidance movement regression with L1 loss.
legacy_cells.AM: Motion-aware attention: pairwise relative-pose features are embedded into per-query key/value features and fused with visual frame tokens.
legacy_cells.BD: Relative probe pose: x, y, z translation and yaw, pitch, roll Euler angles; units and action timing are not specified.
legacy_cells.BS: Predicted target visual features; an RCDM diffusion model maps predicted features to ultrasound images for qualitative visualization.
legacy_cells.BT: Guidance prediction head regresses probe movement toward target standard planes.
legacy_cells.BV: Lspatial masked-feature L1 loss; Lmotion InfoNCE loss (combined as Lspatial + λLmotion, λ = 0.1); Lguide L1 movement-regression loss.
legacy_cells.DN: Unnamed routine cardiac ultrasound scan dataset
legacy_cells.DQ: 356 routine scans and approximately one million image frames; 284 scans for training and 72 for testing.
legacy_cells.EI: Single-frame probe-guidance comparison: EchoWorld had the lowest error in 16/20 translation/rotation subtasks and beat the best alternative (EchoCLIP) by 0.22 in average MAE; sequential protocol compared with US-GuideNet, Decision-T, and Seq-aware, with EchoWorld reported to outperform them.
legacy_cells.EK: Ablated spatial and motion world-modeling tasks jointly and separately, and tested the motion-aware guidance module with/without motion signals and with DeiT versus EchoWorld backbones.
legacy_cells.FB: Per-frame learned ultrasound visual features (pooled ViT patch embeddings) plus relative probe-pose motion features; predicts target-frame features.
legacy_cells.FL: ViT-Small encodes ultrasound images and a motion encoder embeds relative 6-DOF probe pose; a JEPA-style predictor learns masked anatomical and motion-conditioned target features. A motion-aware attention module aggregates historical image-motion tokens, and a guidance head regresses movement toward a target plane. A diffusion decoder is used for image visualizations; no planner is implemented.
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces a cardiac-ultrasound JEPA-style pretraining framework combining masked anatomical feature prediction and motion-conditioned feature prediction, followed by motion-aware attention for probe guidance.
legacy_cells.FN: EchoWorld reports the lowest error in 16 of 20 single-frame translation/rotation subtasks and a 0.22 lower averaged MAE than EchoCLIP; it also reports outperforming tested guidance baselines in the sequential protocol.
legacy_cells.FQ: The authors identify limited work on representation learning for ultrasound probe guidance and on integrating visual observations with motion data to model motion-induced visual changes.
legacy_cells.FR: The visual-change evidence is qualitative and does not establish faithful free-running multi-step video simulation; movement-error evaluation on collected scans does not demonstrate causal treatment effects, closed-loop robot success, or prospective clinical benefit.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M4 Action service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Pass the paper’s specified action and time context explicitly into the state-transition interface; preserve the boundary between predictive action sensitivity and identified intervention effects.

notes: EchoWorld pretrains ViT encoders with a JEPA-style latent predictor on masked anatomical regions and on probe-motion-conditioned frame prediction, then fine-tunes a motion-aware attention head to regress relative probe movement to ten standard planes. On 72 held-out scans the single-frame average error is 8.15 against 8.37 for EchoCLIP, and the sequential protocol gives 7.05 against 7.42 for the best reproduced framework. The motion-conditioned predictor is evaluated only by decoded images. Classified not_world_model (supporting component), G01 unresolved, R2. Source points: errors average millimetres and degrees, no variance, offline imitation error only, appendix absent.
